entropy: confirmation_entropy(<commit that adds this file>) in scripts/data/confirmation_cases.py; seed key [entropy, block, role, dim]
shared_start: Latin hypercube of 2d+1 points from the acquisition seed; sglib pays its own nodes only

c2.reconstruction: fixed GP Matern-3/2 primary; 1/2 and 5/2 robustness
c2.score: mass-weighted top-decile RMSE per mode / case scale

c2_w: OLS slope of the C2 log ratio on log fit-free peak width l; secondary family, Holm over 6

tests.superiority: 95% upper bound below margin and Holm rejection

grading: 65,536-point scrambled Sobol cloud per block; second scramble as integration check
power_basis: 5-D dev pilot at N = 256 (results/vurs-confirm-dev-5d-2026-10-25): C2 power >= 0.94 at 40 blocks/stratum; N = 512 adopted by user decision, power at 512 not separately simulated
